title: GPT-4o reads the mind in the eyes

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model accuracy and error structures when inferring mental states from images of White versus Non-White faces using the Multiracial Reading the Mind in the Eyes Test (MRMET).

Evaluating model accuracy and the disproportionate effects of image inversion on mental state attribution across male versus female face stimuli using the Multiracial Reading the Mind in the Eyes Test (MRMET).
